result.summary: The page looks mostly intact and functional. One minor visual issue was identified related to the notification badge on the top-right avatar/button.

issues.description: The red notification dot on the top-right circular button appears to be partially clipped or positioned inconsistently — it sits at the edge of the circle, which may look unintentional depending on design intent.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the notification badge is properly anchored with consistent offset values (e.g., top-right corner with a defined margin) so it appears clearly outside the button boundary without being clipped.
